metadata.title: Chip stocks post big drop in tech selloff - MarketWatch

content.text:
Oct. 22, 11:57am ET
Chip stocks post big drop in tech selloff
Semiconductor companies are having a particularly bad day as investors dump technology stocks.
The PHLX Semiconductor Index was sliding 6% on Thursday, on track for its biggest drop since July 1, according to FactSet data, at last check. Chip stocks such as Advanced Micro Devices, Intel and Nvidia all had big losses as midday approached.
